articles.title: EasyJet investors back Apollo buyout as deal moves closer to completion
articles.summary: Investing.com -- EasyJet shareholders approved Apollo’s takeover of the budget airline on Wednesday, clearing a key hurdle for the deal, which still requires court sanction and regulatory approvals and is expected to complete in the first quarter of 2027.

articles.title: EasyJet passengers to get Wi-Fi within months after deal with Musk
articles.summary: EasyJet has signed a deal with Elon Musk’s Starlink to offer satellite Wi-Fi on its flights.

articles.title: Pilots fear for jobs after £5.7bn easyJet takeover
articles.summary: Pilots at easyJet have raised fears about significant job losses after the airline’s £5.7bn takeover by a US private equity giant.
